title: Single intrinsic closure predicates beyond P2
scope: Evaluate one neutral intrinsic predicate drawn from P5/P1/F27 over the Step-28 neutral P2-closer carrier.
audit: run_step29.py validates the computed survivor count, reference status, anti-smuggle scan, ablations, negative controls, Stage II, source paths, and no-overclaim boundaries.
note: The predicate narrows 280983 P2 closers to 1851 while keeping the reference support; it is not equivalent to the target.
non_triviality_argument: Ablation shows all three components are load-bearing and negative controls show the predicate is not a row picker.
excluded_designs_rationale: Excluded designs: slot-count locks, exterior-only ansatz, larger-group recognition priors, target-shape primitives, and target-support tests.
